subject: Creating New Variables from Latent Variables

messages.author: 02146bdae488202b
messages.subject: Creating New Variables from Latent Variables
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to create a new variable that is basically a transformation of a previously defined latent variable. What I've tried so far is something like this:

neuro_f =~ 1*per3i4.2.f + per3i9.2.f_r + per3i14.2.f + per3i19.2.f
neuro_m =~ 1*per3i4.2.m + per3i9.2.m_r + per3i14.2.m + per3i19.2.m

## quadratic terms ##
neuro_f_sq := neuro_f*neuro_f
neuro_m_sq := neuro_m*neuro_m


When I try to use these two variables later on, e.g., like this:

sat3.3.f ~ partner1*neuro_m + partner2*neuro_m_sq

lavaan tells me that neuro_m_sq and neuro_f_sq are unknown observed variables.

So, is there a way to define new latent variables from a transformation other latent variables in lavaan? Any thoughts appreciated.

Best,

Marcus

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Creating New Variables from Latent Variables
parts:
## quadratic terms ##
neuro_f_sq := neuro_f*neuro_f
neuro_m_sq := neuro_m*neuro_m
The := operator is for defining new parameters, not new variables.
is there a way to define new latent variables from a transformation other latent variables in lavaan?

lavaan cannot estimate products among latent variables (quadratic or interactions).  You can use product indicators (read the References on the ?semTools::indProd help page) in lavaan, or you can use latent moderated structures (LMS) in the nlsem package or Mplus.

Terrence D. Jorgensen

messages.subject: Re: Creating New Variables from Latent Variables
parts: I use indProd in the same syntax to use a latent interaction term, but I also need these quadratic terms.

quadratic is the same as interaction of a variable with itself (i.e., the effect of X depends on the level of X), so you do the same thing you would for interactions, but the indicators of the "first" latent are the same as the indicators of the "second" latent.
